project_overview.tagline: গ্রামের সেরা পণ্য, সরাসরি আপনার দরজায়
project_overview.description: A video-first (Reels/Shorts style) e-commerce marketplace connecting rural producers directly with urban buyers in Bangladesh. Featuring immersive vertical video feeds, escrow payment protection, direct rural seller trust metrics, bKash/Nagad checkout, and a full super admin panel.
project_overview.language: Bangla (১০০% ক্লিন ও আধুনিক বাংলা ইউআই)
project_overview.design_archetype: Organic & Earthy + Kinetic Video E-Commerce Hybrid

bangla_formatting_rules: Always set global CSS body { font-family: 'Hind Siliguri', sans-serif; -webkit-font-smoothing: antialiased; }
Ensure line-height is at least 1.5 or leading-relaxed for Bangla script to prevent text clipping on diacritics (মাত্রাও কার চিহ্ন).
Use Bengali numerals (০, ১, ২, ৩, ৪, ৫, ৬, ৭, ৮, ৯) or BDT currency symbol (৳) formatted cleanly, e.g., '৳ ৮৫০' instead of 'Tk 850'.

video_reel_card.description: Full height vertical video player card with floating interaction overlays and shop CTA.

elements.video_player: HTML5 <video> with auto-play observer, click-to-toggle play/pause, double-tap heart gesture, sound toggle button top-right.
elements.top_bar: Search bar icon, sound mute button, GramerGhor BD branding logo with glowing green dot ('লাইভ').
elements.right_action_bar: Vertical floating stack on bottom-right containing: Seller Avatar with green '+' button, Heart/Like button with live count, Comment button with count badge, Share button, Cart badge.
elements.bottom_product_overlay: Glassmorphic gradient panel featuring: Seller location tag (e.g. '📍 বগুড়া' or '📍 সুন্দরবন'), Seller trust badge ('১০০% খাঁটি'), Product title in bold Hind Siliguri, Price tag ('৳ ৮৫০ / কেজি'), 'দ্রুত অর্ডার করুন' primary CTA button.

order_modal_flow.description: Streamlined 3-step checkout drawer with Escrow and bKash/Nagad integration.
order_modal_flow.step_1: Delivery Information (Name, Mobile Number, District/Division select, Thana, Village/House address in Bangla).
order_modal_flow.step_2: Escrow Payment Selection (ক্যাশ অন ডেলিভারি / বিকাশ / নগদ). Displays GramerGhor Escrow Protection Guarantee ('আপনার টাকা আমাদের কাছে নিরাপদ, পণ্য বুঝে পাওয়ার পর বিক্রেতা পাবেন').
order_modal_flow.step_3: Transaction Submission (Displays official bKash/Nagad merchant number `01700-123456`, copy button, and TrxID input box with live validation).

sections: Header banner with rural landscape photo and seller profile avatar with green verified badge.
Trust Badges: '১০০% খাঁটি পণ্য' (100% Pure), 'সরাসরি কৃষক' (Direct Farmer), '২৪-৪৮ ঘণ্টার ডেলিভারি'.
Metrics Grid: মোট অর্ডার সম্পন্ন (Completed Orders e.g. '৪৫০+'), গড় রেটিং ('৪.৯★'), গড় ডেলিভারি সময় ('১.৫ দিন').
Grid of seller's product videos and items.

comment_drawer.description: Slide-up sheet for real-time customer discussions and questions.
features: Scrollable comment list with user avatars, name, timestamp, Bangla text, and 'রিপোর্ট করুন' (Report to admin) flag button.
Input bar with emoji picker shortcuts and 'মন্তব্য পাঠান' submit button.

super_admin_dashboard.description: Comprehensive control panel for platform metrics, moderation, and finance.
sections: Live Metric Cards: মোট বিক্রয় (Total GMV e.g. '৳ ৪,৫২,০০০'), মোট বিক্রেতা (Active Sellers), পেন্ডিং এসক্রো টাকা (Pending Escrow), অনুমোদন অপেক্ষমাণ ভিডিও (Videos Pending Approval).
Commission Controller: Interactive slider to adjust platform commission percentage (0% to 15%, e.g. 'বর্তমান কমিশন: ৫%').
Gateway Manager: Toggles for bKash, Nagad, and Cash on Delivery with status indicators.
Video Moderation Queue: Table showing video preview, seller name, product title, and action buttons ('অনুমোদন দিন' / 'বাতিল করুন').
User & Seller Management: Ban/Verify toggle and report investigation modal.

bangla_legal_pages.description: Bangla privacy policy and escrow rules modal or full footer view.
bangla_legal_pages.content: বিস্তারিত গোপনীয়তা নীতি (Privacy Policy) এবং গ্রামেরঘর ট্রাস্ট এসক্রো সুরক্ষার নিয়মাবলী.

motion_and_interactions.scroll_snap: CSS scroll-snap-type: y mandatory with smooth CSS momentum scrolling.
motion_and_interactions.like_animation: Heart pop-up bounce effect on tap using CSS scale transition (`transform scale-125 transition-transform duration-200`).
motion_and_interactions.drawer_transition: Framer motion or Tailwind slide-in-from-bottom (`animate-in slide-in-from-bottom duration-300`).
motion_and_interactions.toast_notifications: Use `sonner` in Bangla, e.g., toast.success('পণ্যটি কার্টে যোগ করা হয়েছে!'), toast.info('TrxID যাচাই করা হচ্ছে...').

data_testids.rules: All interactive elements (buttons, nav items, video controls, form inputs, modals, admin toggles) MUST have kebab-case data-testid attributes.

instructions_to_main_agent: Import Google Font 'Hind Siliguri' in public/index.html or src/index.css and apply globally to the body element.
Implement the Dual-View layout: Mobile full-screen snapping reels feed with sticky bottom bar; Desktop centered framed phone canvas with left/right sidebars for desktop users.
Maintain 100% Bangla language for the user interface text using clean, warm, modern phrasing.
Build the interactive reel video feed with autoplay, mute/unmute toggle, play/pause tap, like button counter, comment drawer, share modal, and 'দ্রুত অর্ডার করুন' escrow checkout button.
Build the complete checkout flow modal with Address, Escrow choice (COD/bKash/Nagad), and TrxID submission input.
Include a Super Admin view toggle in the header or sidebar to manage platform metrics, video approvals, commission slider, and payment gateways.
Add seller profile views with trust metrics badges, completed order stats, and hashtag categories.
Add Sonner toast feedback for cart actions, like actions, copy TrxID, and order submissions.
Ensure every single interactive element has a proper data-testid attribute.

UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.anti_slop: Do not build a plain Vercel gray page. Use warm deep forest greens (#1b4d3e), rich mud amber (#d97706), and high-contrast video overlays.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.font: Use Hind Siliguri for headings and body. Never fallback to default browser serif or generic fonts without Hind Siliguri loaded.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.toast: Use sonner for notifications in Bangla.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.testids: Strict adherence to kebab-case role-based data-testid on buttons, inputs, links, modals, and list items.
